name: State and City Validation — Invalid State and City Entered
goal: User enters an invalid state, then a valid one; then enters an invalid city for the chosen state, then a valid city.
constraints: State and city inputs are not in the allowed mapping on first attempt.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects input, displays correct error, and re-prompts.

phases.description: User enters invalid city for the selected state.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects input, displays correct error, and re-prompts.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
